item.title: First thoughts after watching Wistoria: Wand and Sword episode 20 (season 2, episode 8)
item.description:
This post includes a spoiler.

I watched Wistoria: Wand and Sword episode 20 twice. 6/10. Story was 3/5, animation was 3/5, voices and audio were 3/5. This was just preparation for the Second Bloom, and I didn't have many thoughts.

The main topic in this episode was more like, what was Wis? Wis was an unknown kind of magic and many people didn't know the details, and there was no book describing it. I guess that was inherited from his ancestors over 500 years and he got that power, but it was still unclear what it was.

It was a good backstory for Julius, explaining why he became selfish and unkind. That was way too much, though — losing his first love, especially when the person he loved was years older than him and he was very young. And he's still dragging it around at his age. But still, he tried to do everything he could to achieve his goal and that showed how determined and ambitious he was.

Who was Cerridwen? Will thought she used to be with him for a long time, so, was she actually his mother, or did she just have a similar vibe to Workner? Elfie seemed to rely on her, too, so she might've been someone they knew for a long time. No idea about the relationship between her and Julius though.

And I thought Kreutz would turn out to be a good guy, but it looks like he won't and this character might be drawn as a villain. Maybe my view of him will change, but that seems unlikely. And also, it's a defect of the Tower's Bloom system to let someone like Kreutz interfere with which candidates a faction can pick when he's responsible for the first floor.

As for Iris, if she liked Will so much, how could she treat him like that? Will was definitely her favorite, I know that, but how could she use him as a Watcher? The argument between Iris and Elfie was, like, Elfie could've done better in the previous Bloom. So, Iris had every right to ask him to join now.

item.title: First thoughts after watching Wistoria: Wand and Sword episode 19 (season 2, episode 7)
item.description:
This post includes a spoiler.

I watched Wistoria: Wand and Sword episode 19. 7/10. Story was 3/5, animation was 3/5, voices and audio were 3/5. Well, this episode was about Will being scouted by 5 factions. Then one of the high mages started complaining and threw a monster he had no way to beat at Will, and he couldn't defeat it. So, Will and Julius started training for the Second Bloom. That was the story.

The first thought after watching this episode was, again? As Will thought, Kreutz was a similar character to Edward. Magic was the only ability they thought mages needed, so he intended to drop Will. Cariot and Serah tried to hold another Bloom next week, and Zeo wanted Will to have another chance too, as Elfie was about to go ballistic. So, it was kind of a déjà vu story.

But I also felt this was necessary for a few reasons. Will needed to train his Wis. Wis was a pretty new skill and he even defeated Devander without training it, so that was needed. Then Julius needed a second chance so he could join the Ice faction, and he needed to help Will train his Wis. But I liked Julius's plot because it totally makes sense why Elfie didn't choose him. Another thing was Zeo. Among the five factions, he didn't choose Will. And he said something as a reason. He wouldn't get stronger or something like that, and that was something interesting.

Other than these story lines, what felt weird to me was there were 50 people who climbed the tower. But on screen, there were only 5 characters or so who got picked by a faction. And I saw only 6 mages who weren't selected, so somehow there were over 40 characters that were selected by some faction but they weren't really talked about. All of them went to a dark faction or something?

I thought the opening was going to be changed in the previous episode or this one because the opening was all about the Terminalia. But it wasn't, so the opening will keep the same animation until the end, I guess. Well, that happens in some anime, but it was a little unexpected to me.

Watched 2nd time.

Kreutz seemed to be a person like Iida in MHA. It wasn't only his appearance — he was also polite, strict, and too serious about what he believed in. Well, in a later episode, his past will be revealed and he'll turn out to be a good guy.

So, Zeo thought Will would come back and would get stronger. Zeo looked like the type of guy who likes strong, fast, powerful fighters like Will, and this episode showed he was, so it was kinda expected.

Also, when I rewatched Julius's training, I realized he surely had a big brain. He thought seriously about how to get Will into the tower, to earn brownie points from Elfie.

item.title: First thoughts after watching I Made Friends with the Second Prettiest Girl in My Class Episode 10
item.description:
This note includes a spoiler.

I watched I Made Friends with the Second Prettiest Girl in My Class episode 10. 8/10. This episode was on the day of the Christmas party. And mainly, it was about

  1. Maki wanted to talk to Minato
  2. Maki arranged a time for his father and mother to meet
  3. Umi and her friends talked
  4. Maki and Umi started dating

I was wondering what Maki planned to do. Honestly, didn't he do it beforehand? So I was a little let down. And also, I wasn't 100% sure why Minato was part of that scene. Maybe Maki wanted her to see their family's true relationship as he hoped. But the dry relationship between Maki's father and mother was kinda realistic for divorced parents, so I'm glad to see that.

Also, this anime smoothly transitioned from the divorce and broken relationship to Umi's storyline, too. I didn't think it through, but Umi regretted her behavior and the hurtful things she had said to her two friends. I misunderstood that they were in the same school when they came to the school festival. So this Christmas party was the first time for them to meet since then. She apologized to them and said aloud what she should have; they did the same, and they made up. That made me realize Umi was a really great girl who cared about her friends and others a lot.

At the Christmas party, I thought many people would wear dresses, but it seemed only Amami and Umi did. Well, regular people just thought it was a school event, so it kinda makes sense that other people wore their school uniforms. But Amami was definitely the type to wear one, and Umi followed her — and to show Maki, too. And also, it was great that Maki couldn't keep his eyes off Umi even at that time, so he was an honest and loyal guy. And finally they made up. It took 10 episodes.

item.title: First thoughts after watching Wistoria: Wand and Sword episode 18 (season 2, episode 6)
item.description:
This post includes a spoiler.

I watched Wistoria: Wand and Sword episode 18. 7/10. Story was 4/5, animation was 3/5, voices and audio were 3/5. This episode was about preparing clothes to enter the tower, then entering the first floor of the tower, and then starting the selection and the First Bloom.

The overall story was going as normal, nothing special. But, when Elfie was convinced that Will had to show his strength to the tower, I was like, what were they talking about? Defeating Devander itself wasn't enough for them? Or mages in the tower didn't care about the town at all?

I felt a little pity for Julius, though well, there was no need because of what he did to Will already. Obviously, Elfie was not only indifferent to him, but also despised him. He became a comedy character in this series. And also, Julius was not a person who really cared about people or at least Will, and didn't understand why he kept dodging attacks.

Speaking of Will, Will's understanding of Elfie was so deep. Like, how many years did they spend together and how could he understand that much without hearing anything from her, or any of the high mages?

Preparing robes and changing colors based on factions were a nice touch. Of course it was magic, so that made sense. But why was Colette's garb so unique and special compared to the others? She was one of the fan-service characters in this series.

What happens in the next episode? Obviously, the First Bloom will continue, and I think Will will join the Ice faction and he invited Julius too. Then, not sure what will happen afterward. Probably training, or each faction will fight as exercises.

Watched 2nd time. There are 3 animation scenes that are worth calling out to me. When Colette let the mannequins fall down, she was so upset. I didn't understand at first glance, but she did it because they were luxury shops and she didn't want to cause trouble.

Next, when Will ran toward a monster, his glasses showed the monsters. It was detailed but it caught my eye somehow. Maybe because they showed how focused Will was.

Last, when Will used Wiz and then fell down into the fight, he didn't jump. Instead, he let the gravity fall down himself naturally. Why did he just fall? Was he trying to stay calm? Maybe he'd calmed down — or felt cooler-headed — because of Julius's magic.

And what is the Earth faction? Aaron's faction? And why wasn't Aaron there?

item.title: First thoughts after watching Wistoria: Wand and Sword episode 17 (season 2, episode 5)
item.description:
This post includes a spoiler.

I watched Wistoria: Wand and Sword episode 17. 7/10. Story was 3/5, animation was 3/5, voices and audio were 3/5. Well, this episode was the epilogue of the academy arc, and mostly about how they recovered from the last fight, and the graduation ceremony of the academy.

Finn released Will's power and he needed someone to remove his power. It looked like Caldron was able to do it with the Mage Queen's wand, but Finn just watched it so he couldn't. Then he thought he wanted to take Will and also Aaron thought Will should be taken care of by Finn. But somehow, Finn was satisfied that Will climbed the tower, and didn't stop him. What happened? What did he mean by taking him?

As for Will, he was sad because Rosty was broken into pieces and was gone in front of him. So was Colette, and she floated a set of white flowers into a stream. They didn't have his body, so they couldn't make him a grave. That showed a little culture in this world.

When the dean of the academy asked everyone to clap for Will, at first I thought: didn't Colette clap first? Sion was in a good position to do it as he was a rival, but wasn't she the first person who was glad and did that? That felt a little off to me.

So, because this academic arc was over, Eliza, Workner and Edward may not show up afterward? Or will they still be important people in the next episodes?

So, from the next episode, they're going into the tower. Going into the tower doesn't mean they've become Magia Vander, so probably training or something will start. Let's see.

Watched 2nd time. So, the name of the king of the Magia Vander was Aaron, and the head of the academy was Caldron.

I still couldn't get why Finn gave up Will, but Caldron allowed him to enter the tower so maybe that's what he wanted to avoid. I wondered why Colette didn't clap at first but maybe she was crying or walking too long and couldn't clap at first.

Iris could stand in a Magia Vander's meeting and didn't have any shield but just stood there and I wondered how. But she was a 4th year but already a watcher so she could probably use some magic and can protect herself somewhat.

And this episode or the previous episode would have been a good episode to end a season on. I wondered why season 1 couldn't have had more episodes, so it could have included the previous episode or this one. Well, doesn't matter.

The last narration said that the year will be a year of hope and loss. Hope will be definitely Will, and then what is loss? Perhaps the tower will be gone, or that barrier in the sky? Or maybe some Magia Vander will be defeated?

item.title: First thoughts after watching Wistoria: Wand and Sword episode 16 (season 2, episode 4)
item.description:
This post includes a spoiler.

I watched Wistoria: Wand and Sword episode 16. 8/10. Story was 4/5, animation was 5/5, voices and audio were 4/5. This episode was the final episode of the series. Just kidding. This episode was about the fight between Will and Devander, and also kind of the final episode for the prologue.

The fight against Devander was not short but it took almost an entire episode and that was satisfactory. It was great that it wasn't that weak and even the sword was broken earlier, and Elfie's magic was needed for Will. He even used some kind of magic with that sword and Wiz, so why wasn't he discovered? Maybe Finn's involvement was related? If Will alone with the magic was able to defeat it, how much could they go with Magia Vander? That's going to be fun. All other people were just watching. Some people like dwarves and a group who went into a dungeon together cheered him on. But other mages also did, and this reminded me of a character like Naruto. One complaint about the fight scene: the people watching didn't try to search for the headless one or Marze. At least, one of the mages should look for masterminds behind these Devander and monsters because they knew mages using gates reported by Lihanna or others. Well, at least Edward and Serah were in no condition to fight, so it might have been the same for the other professors.

I just remembered that for Will, Colette was nothing but just a friend. She had fallen in love with him, but he had never thought about her as special and always thought of her as one of the other mages. Only Elfie was. What happened between them?

And we finally found out who was the person talking to Will's mother, or at least she seemed to be, Mercedes, and who she was trying to give Will to. That person was Finn. And that made sense that he called Will the sword and also knew Will's power somehow. Who was Mercedes? I guess she was related to Magia Vander, maybe she used to be the leader? That's a bit of a mystery, but she knew they needed the wand and sword to go over the fake of the sky, so at least she saw some problems fighting against enemies outside and couldn't defeat them. Then, maybe Finn knew Elfaria had talent and gave Will to the orphanage so he could get the great sword?

The ending was unique and the full song played, and it was like the ending of a series. The subtitle said it too — it obviously stated the episodes so far were the prologue, and from the next episode it's going to be the main story.

I watched 2nd time. I missed a few things for the 1st time. At first, Mercedes was definitely the person who built the Magia Vander's tower, and the old man called her the Mage Queen. Finn also said it was 500 years ago, so she was definitely not Will's mother, unless Will is actually 500 years old. So, it's likely that the child was Will's ancestor and passed powers down to their descendants. That's the reason why Finn didn't know Will until the last praxis. And how old was Finn? Is he an elf and like 1000 years old?

Then what he used was the fifth element. It looked like it wasn't widely known and only one of the Magia Vander noticed what it was, and not Marze at least.

Finn picked up his glasses and one of the lenses was broken, and the animation showed his reflection only on one lens while talking about a few possible opposite futures of what's going to happen. That was a great animation, actually. On the other hand, Will extended his sword a lot right before he took down the Devander, but it looked like he used the base of the blade to cut it down, so it looked useless. Well, just big animation for fun. And why did he build an ice castle while cutting down many monsters lol

Alright. So, next episode will probably finally go into the tower, and meet Elfaria, but also, probably will go outside of town or even the false sky.

item.title: First thoughts after watching I Made Friends with the Second Prettiest Girl in My Class Episode 9
item.description:
This note includes a spoiler.

I watched I Made Friends with the Second Prettiest Girl in My Class episode 9. 7/10. This episode included

  1. Maki was accepted to join the Christmas party
  2. Maki talked with his mother about the truth about their living expenses
  3. Maki visited Umi's house

The main part of this episode was how Maki reacted to seeing Umi's family while they had a normal conversation like a family does, and that reminded Maki of his family's past Maki's past with his family was short, simple, but still sad enough for a character of a slice-of-life anime. And his reaction was quiet, but he couldn't stop crying — exactly like his character, who cared about others and who didn't attack or blame others. And Umi was, well, maybe the ideal girl who chased him regardless of whether he ran away or not, and calmed him down and stayed with him. It was well drawn that she thanked him in earlier episodes that he meant a lot to her, and also, Maki didn't recognize it. From Maki's perspective, she was the first friend who was nice to him and got along with him, so probably he thought it was nothing special. Now, come to think of it, he didn't have any friends because he moved schools from time to time, so his family was everything to him, and I can imagine the divorce of his parents hurt a lot.

The other parts are minor. Early in this episode, Amami was unwilling to see Umi's brother, but this episode didn't show how creepy his behavior was. Only Umi described what his behavior was like. Umi's father was very tall, a head taller than Maki, but like Maki, he was kind, and Umi's mother always led the conversation. It wasn't such a shock that Maki's mother didn't say anything about the living expenses she was trying to earn without using the money she got from Maki's father. I still don't exactly know what happened between them, but she might be kinda stubborn, or hasn't forgiven what he did. In the scene where Umi caught Maki after he ran away, the background was someone's house decorated cleanly and brightly for Christmas, so that brightness and beauty made it clear they were moving forward in a good way. Before he ran away, it was a plain street without good lighting, so at that time, it showed how depressed Maki was.

There were a few things wrong about the nitty-gritty. Maki started running away and Umi was trying to catch up. But they were just eating dinner and went out suddenly, so running in such a condition should hurt them and it was hard to run. They were emotional and they didn't care about that, though. Also, when Umi was trying to make Maki sleep in her lap, the camera was from Maki's eyeline. But it looked at Umi, though he was obviously looking in a different direction, so I wanted the previous cut to be consistent.

Well, anyway, what I wanted to say was they were a match made in heaven, even compared to any other anime. I don't know what Maki will do in the next episode, but he'll probably invite his parents to the school's Christmas party and try to get them to work out their arguments. And they would start living together, but I guess it won't happen.

item.title: First thoughts after watching I Made Friends with the Second Prettiest Girl in My Class Episode 8
item.description:
This note includes a spoiler.

I watched I Made Friends with the Second Prettiest Girl in My Class episode 8. 5/10. This episode included

  1. Study group at Maki's home for the next exam
  2. Dinner with Maki's father and met Nitta afterward
  3. Talked to Umi

Well, if you want a romantic relationship between Maki and Umi, then this episode is great. The early part of this episode was especially good — their interaction while they studied with Amami and Seki together. Another interesting part was Amami's personal preference was similar to Maki's, and she wanted to date someone like him. Well, maybe she just had a big appetite and a sweet tooth, and wanted to eat them. Umi heard these things and worried about Maki, and said that she had put up with it in the past when Amami took her friends — Honoka, and one more whose name I forgot. But she definitely couldn't. If she had been able to, she wouldn't have changed high schools in the first place. So she worried but at the same time, her sadness faded because of Maki.

This episode also showed who was smart, and Amami and Seki weren't as smart as Umi and Maki. So, Amami's other weakness was actually studying.

In terms of the dinner scene with Maki's dad, well, I kinda understood and kinda felt weird when Maki was angry. He was angry because his dad loved another woman but found out he loved her after he had divorced Maki's mom. He also saw that his mom looked wiped out so from that kindness, it made sense that he couldn't forgive. At the same time, they were divorced, so even if he was their son, didn't it make sense?

Well, and Nitta somehow played a role in calming Maki down. She's been a kinda convenient character so far. Probably she also talked to Umi and Umi set up the dinner with her family and Maki next time.

Well, nothing too special. In the next episode, Maki will see a normal family life and then, I'm not sure what's going to happen. Maybe he will get mad and argue with Umi, or the opposite and relieved with their life? Let's see.

item.title: First thoughts after watching I Made Friends with the Second Prettiest Girl in My Class Episode 6
item.description:
This note includes a spoiler.

I watched I Made Friends with the Second Prettiest Girl in My Class episode 6. 6/10.

  • Story and characters: 4/5
  • Design and animation: 3/5
  • Voices and audios: 3/5

The episode started basically with:

  1. The dream about the time when Maki cried out to his dad.
  2. Planning for this Christmas Eve.
  3. Seki's confession to Amami.
  4. Maki's preparation for his next date with Umi.

In this episode, finally, Maki's dad was mentioned, and unlike some MCs in other anime, he had a reason why he didn't live with his dad. And that seemed to be his trauma or something as he dreamed about it. And it also influenced his personality, and he wanted to be a better guy for Umi before officially dating her. At least we know why his character was something like this.

Nitta and Seki finally talked a lot in this episode, and they are also animated in the opening. I am still unsure about Nitta's personality honestly, but Seki was a baseball jock and takes action quickly rather than thinking too much, and confessed to Amami. He didn't really talk to her so obviously she turned him down, and because of that, he and Maki became friends. So, I think this person will get along with Maki a lot later.

People knew about Maki and Umi's relationship, but some people didn't know they weren't dating. Because Seki mentioned that Umi got popular in those days, as I guessed in the previous episode, another hot guy will show up and become Maki's rival in a later episode. Well, or rather, it's more accurate to say they were already dating and just didn't admit it. It was ironic that Umi was more like a lead all the time but she was blushing when she talked about Maki with someone else.

There were a lot of low-angle shots showing legs a couple of times in this episode. The first was while Umi and Maki were talking in his room, and it was like, why? Heads or the upper body can show the slight behaviors of each character better than the movement of the lower body while they were sitting. It also happened while they were walking in a shopping mall. This can show the movements and also cut animation and drawing costs, so maybe this was fine.

For the next episode, I wasn't sure how his dad will be involved in the story. Maybe Maki couldn't go to the date and Umi figured it out, but then, what? I cannot guess. Either his mom will find a new man or they will get back together might be the best one but I don't know what is a good one.

item.title: First thoughts after watching Wistoria: Wand and Sword episode 15 (season 2, episode 3)
item.description:
This post includes a spoiler.

I watched Wistoria: Wand and Sword episode 15. 9/10. Story was 5/5, animation was 4/5, voices and audio was 4/5.

The overview of this episode was from Will's perspective:

  1. Will was saved by Workner on his dragon but disappeared because Rosty was killed.
  2. They were shot down by a masked man and Workner was fatally wounded in front of Will.
  3. Finn arrived at the village and Will was awakened.
  4. Will wiped out monsters and confronted Devander, which was fighting Sion and Colette.

From perspectives other than Will's, mages and dwarves mostly ran around and dealt with monsters, and Magia Vander argued with each other. Some wanted to come down from the tower and some disagreed.

The situation was like hell and it was great to see that it was dire and hopeless, not only characters just said it was a hell which looked different from reality. A few students and mages died but monsters impervious to magic were hard for mages to fight, except maybe Eliza. What type of magic did she cast? I had no idea, unfortunately. It looked like she materialized needles out of blood, and those physical objects could kill them. Edward's words and actions were also great. He was so logical that he weighed his own life and saved dwarves. He was calmly passionate and serious. Well, but the most shocking one was Workner. He got a hole in his heart, quite literally, after the battle with one of the masterminds. I wondered if he saved himself or Finn saved him.

I still don't know who Finn was. Obviously he was in a position like the Magia Vander in a sword world, or maybe even higher. He put some magic, or just blood, into one of the swords and that made Will much faster and stronger, so Finn himself was for sure in the position of one of the strongest characters in this series. I was a little bit questioning why he didn't do it himself, or whether he was going to help Will later. Will was down in the dumps at that time, but Finn had a strong belief that even changed Will's mind quickly and Will moved again. By the way, Wiz was the name of a sword, not spell which I guessed the answer of the subtitle of this episode, so I'm not sure whether that sword is special or whether there are similar swords.

Will was, repeating what he was in season 1, but finally awakened and arrived at Devander where Colette and Sion were. Colette was trying to figure out where Will was with Kiki, but Will had become too fast and reached her. Also, she faced Devander so couldn't move from there.

In this episode, it also showed the characters of the Magia Vander. They used to talk and showed their characters a little, but in this episode, Elfaria showed her emotion a lot and that was a good one. Well, before she got happy seeing Will was awakened, she was trying to intimidate one of the old men of the Magia Vander, so I wondered what happened in between scenes, though.

The music was also good in the episode, because this was a very important scene for Will to change. It was the kind of music that told us Will was going to improve and look up, but I'm a stranger to music so cannot say what it was.

The animation was good and considering the next episode will be an important episode, the animation will peak, probably.

Watched 2nd time.

Well, after watching this episode again, most characters were still alive, so it wasn't that much of a hell. Most of mobs were victims. I didn't know what happened to Serah, though.

Also, why didn't Marze follow Will and kill him? He thought he did, or he noticed Finn was close? Not sure, there was no reaction or scene for him, so even if he believed he killed Workner, he didn't finish Will off. Speaking of Workner, it was a good scene where the camera was behind Workner after he took damage from Marze, showing how desperate his situation was.

And Edward used bad words even though he was always dedicated to the bigger scheme.

Actually, I wasn't sure what the magic Will used was called. Probably I can see it next.

item.title: First thoughts after watching I Made Friends with the Second Prettiest Girl in My Class Episode 5
item.description:
This note includes a spoiler.

I watched I Made Friends with the Second Prettiest Girl in My Class episode 5. 9/10.

  • Story and characters: 5/5
  • Design and animation: 3/5
  • Voices and audios: 3/5

The earlier part of this episode was that Umi started talking about her past and the reactions there, and then Umi and Maki talked in a classroom. The later part was that Umi talked with Amami on the roof with Maki again, and then they hung out in Maki's room before they called it a day. I didn't expect this episode was still on the school festival day, and I thought it had finished in the previous episode, but I was wrong.

I like the overall story in the episode. This episode showed how Umi really felt about Amami, and it wasn't very simple. It was love and hate. I also wondered why she talked with the other 2 girls, but her past explained it well, and that was also sad but at the same time a pretty natural thing, too, because human relationships can change over time. And that explained why Umi and Amami at least went to that high school, instead of moving up to the high school attached to their middle school, which they could have entered without taking an exam. Although, I wasn't sure why other girls also followed them and entered the same school. They were at least really friends with Amami, supposedly.

Also, when Maki found Umi alone in a classroom after she left the roof, she cried but didn't cry aloud and kept talking with him. I thought she might've cried a lot as characters in other anime often do, but she didn't, and that was good, and more genuine. Moreover, she still cared about Amami at that time, so she really was kind to her.

I wondered why Amami asked those 2 things of Umi and Maki, but then I think she wanted Maki to be the one who never left Umi, perhaps? Maybe she also had a complex feeling at that time because she wanted to be the best friend of Umi. I didn't fully understand what she was trying to do when she was playing a ghost, but maybe she wanted to see how Umi talked with him and wanted to feel the difference, and just got her head around it.

Umi showed her more decisiveness and initiative than Maki at the end of this episode. He wasn't familiar with being around people, so he wasn't very brave, and the episode showed these things well even at the end. And she also still was a little playful. Anyhow, overall, episode 5 wrapped up one arc of the plot so far. Maybe this was the first volume of the original light novel, I guess. It was a clean, well-organized, convincing story that brought the characters to life.

For animations, I felt like when Umi and Amami were at the 3rd year grade, their heads were too big as a character design. Then when they became 1st years in middle school, they were almost identical to how they look in high school. Also, Umi's eye color is red, and nothing was said about it, though the color of Amami's eyes was mentioned and some kids stayed away from Amami because of her eye color. Which one is weirder. Well, that's anime world.

What's going to come? item.description:
Contents

  • Lightning animation
    • 1. Base layer
    • 2. Core lightning layer
    • Variations of Advanced Lightning
      • Bouncey
      • Anywhere

I appreciated the next video which explains how to make the effect in details.

Lightning animation

This section was written on July, 2026.

Next animation was the one I made by following steps:

1. Base layer

  1. Create new solid layer
  2. Add an effect Advanced Lightning and set following properties:
    • Glow Settings > Forking to 0, to remove lightning hairs
    • Change other settings on Glow settings and Core Settings to get what you want
  3. Animate the layer by
    • Clicking the stop watch on the Conductivity State
    • Set the different values of Conductivity State in a few key frames

2. Core lightning layer

This will change the color of the core of the lightning to the color you want It's because core and glow settings use screen-style blend instead of normal blend. So if the core color is a bright color like white, this isn't necessary.

  1. Duplicate the first layer.
  2. Set the properties on the new layer:
    1. Set Glow Settings > Radius to 0
    2. Set Core Settings > Color to the color you want
  3. On the previous layer, set Core Settings > Radius to 0

Then I was able to get what I wanted. The video did pre-compose the new layer, add Fill effect and change the color of the effect, but I didn't see any difference.

Variations of Advanced Lightning

The above lightning only goes from top to bottom, because the Lightning Type is Direction. We can get some different animations with different lightning types. Here are a few examples I played around.

However, for more details about Advanced Lightning effect, next video was the most helpful for me to walk through the details:

Bouncey

Here is the lightning animation with Bouncey Lightning Type.

Anywhere

If it's set as "Anywhere", the lightning goes everywhere. The example of the animation is next:

Rough steps to create this was

  1. Add new solid layer with Advanced Lightning effect, and set
    1. Lightning Type to Anywhere
    2. Set Conductivity State to make this animated
    3. Set Forking to 50%
    4. Set Core Settings and Glow Settings as we want to
    5. Enable Composite on Original
    6. Set Outer Radius to make the effect enough to go a lightning from one edge to another
  2. Duplicate the Advanced Lightning 3 times and on each set Origin to put them on 4 edges

item.description:

I appreciated the next video which explains how to make the effect in details. Use audio on the Android App to auto-translate.

Fire animation

This section was written on July, 2026.

The core parts of this frame are

  • Shape layer to draw a shape
  • Use Wave Warp and CC Sphere effects

Next animation was the one I made by following steps:

1. Create a fire with one color

  1. Create a composition main and select it
  2. Select "Path" tool and add a rough shape of a water drop. It should create a "Shape Layer"
    1. Click and drag each point to enable to make the edge round instead of straight lines
  3. Set the colors of Stroke and Fill to orange and name the layer to Orange
  4. Add the effect Wave Warp to the layer and set Property
    1. Wave Type to the Circle
    2. Wave Height 25, Wave Width 80, Direction's angle to 35, for instance
    3. Set Pinning to the Bottom edge
    4. Preview the animation and see if it already looks like a fire
  5. Duplicate the effect and set Properties
    1. Wave Height -25
    2. Direction's angle to -40
  6. In order not to move the bottom of the shape
    1. add new ellipse on the bottom of the shape as a new layer.
    2. Rename the layer as orange_core
    3. Copy 2 effects of Wave Warp effects from the orange layer into the orange_core layer
    4. On the properties on the first Wave Warp
      1. Set the Wave Height to 15
    5. On the properties of the 2nd Wave Warp 3. Set the Wave Type to Smooth Noise 4. Set the Wave Height to 100 5. Set the Wave Speed to 0.5
  7. Adjust the path's shapes of the layer orange when needed

2. Create an inner fire

  1. Duplicate the orange layers and name them to yellow and yellow_core layers
  2. Change the color of the new layers to yellow
  3. Set the paths of the Contents of the yellow layer to make it smaller than orange
  4. Set the properties of the yellow layer
    1. Set the direction to a different value from orange layer, like 3

3. Create sparks

  1. Duplicate the composition main and create sparks 1
  2. In the sparks 1 composition, delete layers o
  3. Set the properties of the 2nd Wave Warp of the layer
    1. Set Wave Height to -150
    2. Set Direction's degree to -36
  4. Duplicate the 2nd Wave Warp, and of the new Wave Warp, set
    1. Wave Type to Smooth Noise
    2. Wave Height to 30
    3. Wave Width to 100
    4. Direction to -40
    5. Wave Speed to 0.5
  5. Duplicate the orange layer and delete 2nd and 3rd Wave Warp effects
  6. Set following properties of the 1st Wave Warp on the new layer:
    1. Wave Type to Uncircle
    2. Wave Height to 230
    3. Wave Width to 135
    4. Direction to -25
    5. Wave Speed to 0.5
  7. Set the Mode of the new layer to Silhouette Alpha to extract all animations that are below those layers by the layer
  8. To make the frame smaller, to set the path of the first layer to smaller

4. Create another sparks

Create sparks for far from the core of a fire

  1. Duplicate the composition "sparks 1" and rename it to "sparks 2"
  2. On the 1st orange layer 3. Set the path to make it wider and a little taller 4. Set the following properties of 2nd Wave Warp effect: 1. Wave Height to 60 from -150
  3. On the 2nd orange layer
    1. Set the path to the similar width as the first layer
    2. Set the following properties of Wave Warp effect:
      1. Wave Height to 200
      2. Wave Width to 100
      3. Direction to -40
  4. In order to make the central part of this animation less, duplicate the 2nd layer
    1. Set the path to thinner
    2. Set the following properties of Wave Warp effect:
      1. Wave Type to Circle
      2. Wave Height to 25
      3. Wave Width to 80
      4. Direction to -36
    3. Duplicate the first Wave Warp effect and set the following properties of new effect:
      1. Wave Type to Smooth Noise
      2. Wave Height to -260
      3. Wave Width to 180
      4. Direction to -40

5. Compose all compositions

  1. Select all compositions, fire, sparks 1, and sparks 2 and create another composition by "New Comp from Selection". Let's say it's "finish"
  2. Add an effect "CC Sphere" on sparks 2 composition in the "finish" composition and set properties of the effect by followings:
    1. Rotation > Rotation Y to 60 degrees
    2. Radius to 400
    3. Light > Light intensity to 0
    4. Shading > Ambient to 100
    5. Set Offset to make them to go around the center 6. Note that I created the animation as the portrait, but that caused this animation failed to go around to the top of the fire composition's fire. The fix was to set the size of composition of spark 2 to the square
  3. Duplicate the composition and update Rotation Rotation Y's degree and offset to make it go around in the other side.
  4. To adjust a few effects, add a new Adjustment layer and on the layer
    1. add "Roughten Edges" effect
      1. And set Border to 4
      2. I cannot see any difference
    2. Add a new effect Posterize Time and set:
      1. Set Frame rate to 12
    3. Add a new effect Glow
      1. Set Glow intensity to 0.7, for example
    4. Duplicate the Glow effect
  5. Adjust properties like colors on each layers for cleaning up

Afterward, the video didn't describe anything, so I updated a few things by myself

  1. Add Fill effect to spark 1 composition to make the color red
  2. I made the spark 2's composition to shorter
  3. Duplicate the spark 2 again, set Transform Y's degree, add Fill effect to change the color

item.title: Anime style speed line effect
item.description:
Contents

  • Speed lines
    • 1. Create a background
    • 2. Create a center light
    • 3. Create the base shadow line layer
    • 4. Add more variations of the shadow lines
    • 5. Create highlights
    • 6. Create corner shadows
  • Corner light variation
    • 1. Create a background in the same way
    • 2. Create the base shadow layer
    • 3. Add shadow and highlight lines
    • 4. Add soft light
    • 5. Add main light
  • Zoom speed lines variation
    • 1. Add speed lines
    • 2. Update speed lines to animate from one point
    • 3. Hide the central point
    • 4. Move the speed lines to the edge of a screen.

I appreciated the next videos which explains how to make the effect in details.

I had followed another video in the middle of the way but stopped because some files were not downloadable.

Speed lines

This section was written in June 28, 2026.

The steps to create lines. I created next animation following these steps:

1. Create a background

Here add a gradient colored background.

  1. Add new layer Solid from New > Solid
  2. Add Gradient Ramp effect. For eaxmple, On the layer, go to Effects > Effects & Presets, search "Ramp" and add it
  3. Set Start Color and End Color, like end color gets darker.
  4. Set Ramp Shape to Radial Ramp
    1. Click and drag the Start of Ramp (the center) and End of Ramp (the outer radius)
  5. Optional? Set Ramp Scatter to like 200 to make it nicer looks

2. Create a center light

  1. Add new Solid Layer and add a Fill effect
  2. Change the Color yellow
  3. Set Transform > Rotation on 45 degrees
  4. Set Transform > Scale to make it cover an entire screen
  5. Set a mask
    1. Select Rectangle Tool on a tool bar and create a Mask on the layer with the part of the central light
    2. Set Mask Feather. For example, 250. It makes a rectangle blur
    3. Set Mask Expansion to make the light wider or narrower.

3. Create the base shadow line layer

  1. Duplicate the center light layer and rename it "Line Shadows 01"
  2. Remove the Fill effect
  3. Add a Fractal Noise effect
  4. Set the Property of the fractal noise effect
    1. Set Contrast to, for example, 2500, to remove blur
    2. Set Brightness to, like 300, to separate white and black are clear
    3. Go to Transform and update the scale to look noises become noises with lines instead of rounded shapes
      1. Disable Uniform Scaling
      2. Increase scale width and decrease scale height
    4. Animate the layer using Transform > Offset Turbulence
      1. Create keyframe on the first layer for Offset Turbulance
      2. Create keyframe on the last layer for Offset Turbulance, and set different values from the first key frame.
    5. Alt-click Sub Settings > Evolution and set time * X in Expression. This is to increase the speed of a line
  5. Change the color of the lines
    1. Set "Blending Mode" to Multiply. I needed to click "Toggle Switches / Modes" on the bottom bar to show the Mode on each layer.
    2. To make the color lighter,
      1. Add an effect CC toner
      2. Change the Tones to Duotone
      3. Set Shadows to the color darker than the background

4. Add more variations of the shadow lines

Add as many layer as you want.

  1. Duplicate the above "Line Shadows 01" layer into new layer
  2. Update some properties to make them look different from the 01 layer. For example,
    1. Update Contrast, Brightness, or Scale
    2. Alt click Sub Settings > Evolution and set the expression like time - 200

5. Create highlights

Add as many layer as you want.

  1. Duplicate some shadows layer of existing highlights layers, and rename those layers to "Line Hightlights 01"
  2. Set Blending Modes of the new layer "Screen"
    1. Or set "Add" in a few layers depending on how they look
  3. Update "CC Toner" effect
    1. Set "Highlights" to the black
    2. Set "Shadows" to the brighter color
  4. Add some variations
    1. Update Fractal Noise > Brightness
    2. Update Fractal Noise > Transform > Offset Turbulance
    3. Update Fractal Noise > Transform > Rotation
  5. Add more variations by adding Glow effect. And update
    1. Glow Threshold
    2. Glow Radius
    3. Glow Intensity

6. Create corner shadows

  1. Duplicate the center light layer and rename it to a "corner shadows" layer
  2. Update the Mode of "Mask 1" to Subtract from Add
  3. Set the Fill > Color black
  4. Set the Transform > Opacity not to make too dark

Corner light variation

This section was written in June 28, 2026.

The above steps can be used for other cases like this animation.

1. Create a background in the same way

2. Create the base shadow layer

On top of the same step as above.

  1. Add Corner Pin effect on the Line Shadows layer
  2. Drag the positions of each edge of the corner pin to move lines from one edge to another edge

3. Add shadow and highlight lines

Add shadow and highlight lines by following the same steps.

4. Add soft light

  1. Add new Solid layer
  2. Add new mask with rounded shape
  3. Set Mask Feather and Mask Expansion
  4. Set Blending Modes to Add
  5. Add Fill effect and set the color

5. Add main light

  1. Add new Solid layer
  2. Set Blending Modes to Screen
  3. Add new mask with light emitting layer
  4. Animate Mask Path by creating multiple key frames with multiple shapes
  5. Add CC radial Radial Fast Blur effect

Zoom speed lines variation

This section was written in July 3, 2026 and result of animation looks like next:

This is the variation explained from the video:

In this video, "Turbulent Noise" effect is used instead of "Fractal Noise". And the most important effect for this zoom version is the

1. Add speed lines

This is almost the same steps as "Create the base shadow line layer" on the above steps

  1. Add new Solid layer, and add Turbulent Noise effect
  2. For the effect on the layer
    1. Set Contract to higher value to reduce blur
    2. Set Brightness to lower value to reduce white pixels
    3. Disable Transform > Uniform Scaling
    4. Set Transform > Scale Width and Transform > Scale Height to such values that lines can be seen.
  3. Animate the effect by

    1. Alt Click Transform > Offset Turbulence

    2. While the entire expression of Offset Turbulence was selected, drag a spiral icon of Offset Turbulence into the offset of Offset Turbulence 3. It should change an expression from effect("Turbulent Noise")(13) to next

       temp = effect("Turbulent Noise")("Offset Turbulence")[0];
[temp, temp]

    3. Update the 2nd line from [temp, temp] to [temp, time * 5000]. This changes the Y axis's value depending on a time frame.

2. Update speed lines to animate from one point

  1. Add new Adjustment layer and add an effect "Polar Coordinates"
  2. For the effect on the new layer
    1. Set Type of Conversion to "Rect to Polar"
    2. Set Interpolation to 100%

3. Hide the central point

  1. Add new Solid layer
  2. Set the background of the layer to Black
  3. Select a mask of "Ellipse tool" and mask the center of the point

4. Move the speed lines to the edge of a screen.

The video explained until the above steps. However, I've seen that there was the empty spaces that lines do not move on the edges.

So in order to make lines move to them, I needed to do these changes.

  1. Pre-compute all layers.
  2. Set Transform > Scale on the composition to make the speed line go to the edges
